contexts.text: There was a certain Church dignitary who had believed himself to be more learned than others...
Because the leading men of the Church can gain nothing by faith alone; but by the preaching of works.
The leading men (of the Papists, Quakers, Jews, and Mohammedans) have so said; and their followers confirm (their doctrinals).

contexts.text: They are like evil leading men of the Church; who, if the truths of doctrine do not serve them as means of acquiring gain, deride them.
How readily the leading men of the Church seize upon [the idea] that such Power has been given to Peter...
In Hell have been seen... both Church dignitaries, and others...
It is believed by the leading men of the Church that he is just and justified who knows the truths of faith... and is thence in confidence...
The leading men of the Church who deny the Divine...
He does not Know that it is true from any other source than because it has so been said by a leading man of the Church...
For scarcely anyone, except a leading man of the Church who teaches and preaches, comprehends these (arcana of justification and salvation by faith alone).
It is from this appearance that the leading men of the Church have given the palm to faith...
The key to open (their theology) is with the leading men of the Church alone.
We cannot think otherwise, because the leading man of our Church... ascribes...
Monks, abbots, priests, prelates. (See also Last Judgment.)
Therefore evil prelates equally with good ones; or prelates who have no faith, equally with those who have faith, can preach the Gospel, in appearance, with a like zeal and affection.
This the doctors and leading men of the Church preach, when they preach from the Word...
All in the First Heaven are in the obedience of doing the truths and goods commanded by... the master or leading man from whom they have heard that this or that is true...
Pilots = the leading men who lead and teach.
This doctrine and this life are with those who form the head of the dragon, who for the most part are leading men of the Church...
Lest the leading men of the Church who are initiated into this dogma, when they are initiated into the priesthood; and, from them, the people of the Church, should be infected by such poison...
As the leading men of the Church speak, when they speak from the Word.
By governors and rulers () are signified principles of falsity and of evil.

Those of this kind who had been leading men of the Church sometimes appear to shine at the mouth...
Their leading men and presbyters, who are called monks, desisted from reading (the Word); saying that the dicta of the Pope are equally holy...
Hence it is that a man says to himself, or a leading man of the Church says to him...
Priests, leaders and ministers...
For anything to be perfect, there must be a trine in just order... In like manner in the Church - a priminfulate, overseers of the parish, and flamens under them.
